title: Finding Support & Help in The Admin Area
text:
## Finding Support & Help in The Admin Area
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000006845
Search for solutions easily in the Admin Account Dashboard.

## Support & Help
The " Support & Help " is found at the bottom of the Admin Dashboard, next to the Website Resources.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12174888915/original/g9UakS8uMbgWSHsfZneSHVFHMTD44T6x1A.png?1771470799 | alt: ]

## Support Documents
Browse help articles and guides: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions

## Create Support Ticket
Report a problem or ask a question: How to Submit a Support Ticket

## Join the Facebook Group
Connect with the BD Community: http://facebook.com/groups/BrilliantDirectories/

## Help Center
Additionally access direct assistance by clicking on the help icon, " HELP CENTER ", that appears on most of the Admin pages:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12174889488/original/zDKwXwkzKj1IGgGUJav2BOiT2-MvTY8RoA.png?1771472151 | alt: ]
Here articles and videos relevant to the page will appear as well as a search bar to search for additional topics within that section of the Admin:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12174889493/original/r4X1diUZzjfc9XQPuROTodmWyXSOvBHzVg.png?1771472175 | alt: ]
